summary:
SL-112 (build 172ab8b) does what the slice owes. Every criterion I could reach held, on the project's own tests and on real data.

**Tests**
- The tree builds with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
- The whole suite passed 1096 of 1096 under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp. No existing test file was modified or deleted.
- UnfinishedTests and UnfinishedBudgetTests passed 8 of 8, with these figures:
  - 101 listing Stops and 47 size-check Stops per worker count.
  - Floors met: shrink-above 48 and 162, later-name-final 105 and 289, corrected-final 220, refused-final 50.
  - 5M-shape store: retained 637.1 MiB, peak 653.5 MiB against 800 MiB; the reads allocate 0 bytes.

**Real data**
- I built a throwaway program against the tree's own Core.dll and ran it on real C:\Windows\System32 and C:\ProgramData: 4 uninterrupted references and 50 real Stops (22 in the listing, 28 in the size checks, before and after a real probe).
- System32 has 538 real probe refusals and 20 unreadable folders. ProgramData has 132–162 real size corrections, 17 refusals and 488 unreadable folders.
- Results:
  - 52,441 final folders, each equal to the uninterrupted scan.
  - 84,865 unfinished folders, none with an at-least figure above it.
  - Unfinished, SizeCheckPending and AtLeast agreed with an independent flags-and-Parent-walk check: 0 misses, 0 over-marks, 0 at-least differences.
  - The StoppedInSizeChecks flag was right on every Stop.
  - The 4 completed reference scans marked nothing, and at-least equalled the rolled figures everywhere.

**Window cases**
- L-001 and L-004 passed.
- WindowMutants -Mutant All, which Q-114 requires here, passed all 12 mutants in 382 s.

**Rules**
- The rules harness under the engine's venv: 169 of 169 rows as recorded, 0 stray hits.
- RuleCases C-001 and C-003 held, and the Fitness check reports all 100 rules hold.

**O-001 (nothing writes the store after Scan returns)**
- By reading the code: EndSizeChecks is called only as the first statement of Finish, the fitness rule holds, and ProbePass has no reference to the store.
- I re-ran the stuck-worker test and tried two mutations:
  - A watermark rewrite 30 ms after Scan returns turns NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned red (625 entries differ).
  - The same rewrite 300 ms after return survives. The test only looks while the workers wind down, which is what the plan asked for. Sealing the store against later writes is already carried to SC-408. The source was restored and `git status src` is clean.

**Header wording**
- Both headers depart from the decided questions' quoted text: the listing header from Q-283, the sizing header from Q-111.
- In each case the dropped clause is 'are short'. Measurements contradict it, and after a Stop in the size checks it is empty, because no row is marked then. These departures were declared by the build and recorded through critique finding m1 (O-026).

**Not reached:** real stale-hardlink or downward corrections (both real folders gave none), the App showing the new reads (SC-393), a whole-drive or stalled-share Stop, and Windows 10.

My scratch folder was removed, the build servers were shut down, and the git tree is as it was.

checks.evidence: EndSizeChecks: defined ScanStore.cs:534 (rejects outside 0..Count), called only at Scanner.cs:583 as Finish's first statement; every Execute return goes through Finish; _uncheckedFrom set only in SizeBatch's Cancelled branch (entries[0]); SizeFiles' only false returns are the two SizeBatch calls; ProbePass has 0 store references. No new per-entry column: ScanStore gains one int field.

checks.what: Header strings against the decided questions
checks.evidence: Sizing arm: '...Every folder was listed, but not every file's own size was read, so any row, unmarked ones included, may be off, on disk especially.' Listing arm: '...Rows marked not read yet or stopped partway leave out what the scan did not reach. No sizes have been checked yet, so any row's size may be off, on disk especially.' Both drop 'are short' from Q-111's and Q-283's quoted text; survey run A and the at-least spike (20,998 above) contradict that clause, and no row is marked after a sizing Stop. The deviation is declared and disposed under O-026; Q-160's 'name Done rows and on-disk' is met by 'unmarked ones' (how a Done row reads) and 'on disk especially'.

checks.evidence: Not required: the slice does not touch FolderTreeNode, the tree in MainWindow, or ScanStore.ChildrenLargestFirst (only ListHeader and new ScanStore reads). Q-279 also records T-003 red from this display regardless.

checks.evidence: A whole-drive scan needs the person's allow, and Q-176 permits W-001 unattended only for SL-089's checks; L-001 asserts the same string.

criteria.criterion: 1. Mark folders unfinished at Stop when Stop lands in the listing (every AfterFolder point, sampled guarded calls incl. calls 1-2, a folder cut mid-listing, a listing that returned cleanly after Cancel)
criteria.how: StopsInTheListingMarkWhatAPendingCheckCouldChange passed (101 stops: 4 empty stores, 10 mid-commit). On real System32 and ProgramData, 22 listing Stops (first folder, last folder, random) gave 0 differences against an independent Parent-walk check and 0 final-folder mismatches.

criteria.criterion: 2. Stop in the size checks while the next batch is queued or at a batch boundary (workers 1 and 4, ProbeBatch=8)
criteria.how: The Theory's part (i) passed for 1 and 4 workers with 15 queued landings each, and it asserts that the cancelled batch started no probe.

criteria.criterion: 3. Stop with a probe in progress inside a batch, before and after the real probe returned
criteria.how: 28 mid-batch Stops per worker count passed. On real data, 28 size-check Stops cancelled inside a real probe call (before and after it returned) gave 0 mismatches, and the flag was right on every one.

criteria.criterion: 4. Every probe worker stuck in an uncancellable call; Scan returns by the abandon wait
criteria.how: 4 stuck Stops per row in the Theory, plus NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned with 12 calls for each of 1 and 4 workers, all passed.

criteria.criterion: 5. Pending stale-small hardlink first name (later name in an ancestor, beside it, or a later sibling), stopped in the listing and in the size checks
criteria.how: Engineered temp trees: groups A, C, E and G; the first-name-pending floor was met (65 in the listing, 22 in the size checks), and their folders and ancestors were Unfinished. Real folders had no stale hardlinks, so this was not seen on real data.

criteria.criterion: 6. Pending stale-large first name: folders it moves bytes away from are marked, and 'at least' holds
criteria.how: Shrink-above floor met (162 and 48 Stops where the rolled figure is above the reference while AtLeast is not). In my real runs, 84,865 unfinished folders had an at-least figure no higher than the reference.

criteria.criterion: 7. A folder is final only when its figures equal the uninterrupted scan's (later name's folder final while the first name is pending; first name corrected before Stop)
criteria.how: Floors met: later-name-final 105 and 289, corrected-final 220. On real data, 52,441 final folders equalled the reference, 40 of them with a real correction inside.

criteria.criterion: 8. A file whose check was refused (ProbeFailed, error 5) before the cutoff
criteria.how: refused-final 50 through the seam. On real data, 538 (System32) and 17 (ProgramData) real refusals counted as checked, with 0 disagreements and 0 mismatches.

criteria.criterion: 9. A folder's descendant range on synthetic scanner-order stores (page straddle, CloudOnly, duplicates, links, watermark 0, Count and random points, empty store)
criteria.how: TheReadAnswersAsAParentWalkOnEveryScannerShapedStore passed. My real-tree check against an independent Parent walk, over 50 Stops on 1,948 and 4,409-folder real trees, found 0 misses, 0 over-marks and 0 at-least differences.

criteria.criterion: 10. Nothing changes once Stop has taken effect (listing returned cleanly after Cancel committed before return; store at return vs later)
criteria.how: NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned passed. Its dump includes pending, unfinished and at-least, so it reads the watermark. Per finding m5 (O-021), the vacuous 200 ms comparison for the listing row is replaced by an assertion that the folder was committed whole. A watermark rewrite 30 ms after return turned it red; one 300 ms after return survives (recorded as extra).

criteria.criterion: 11. A scan that runs to the end marks nothing (sweep tree, 5 files vanished before their check, folders-only tree)
criteria.how: AScanThatRunsToTheEndMarksNothing passed. My 4 real completed reference scans had 0 Unfinished, 0 SizeCheckPending, and at-least equal to the rolled figures on every entry.

criteria.criterion: 12. Existing counting-rule and last-access tests pass unedited under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp
criteria.how: The modify/delete diff over tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests is empty, and the whole suite passed 1096 of 1096 under that TEMP.

criteria.criterion: 13. The trace adds no per-entry column and fits the budget (5M U-201 shape at the unlisted peak and listed to the end with checks 97% done)
criteria.how: The diff adds one int field and no page column. Budget test: retained 637.1 MiB, peak 653.5 / 653.4 MiB against 800 MiB; the reads allocate 0 bytes; 100k-child rows took 28.7 and 5.7 ms.

criteria.criterion: 14. The stopped header says what a Stop in the size checks did (FSA_HOOK_AT_SIZED=0, at least 60,000 files), compared against a listing Stop
criteria.how: L-004 passed (sizing header, different from the listing one) and L-001 passed. WindowMutants -Mutant All passed 12 of 12.

planned.evidence: The listing and size-check Facts passed (101 listing Stops; 47 size-check Stops per worker count across queued, mid-batch and stuck). Independently: 50 real Stops of System32 and ProgramData, where every folder above a pending check read Unfinished, with 0 misses against a Parent-walk check.

Engineered temp trees with grow and shrink groups across folders (ancestor, beside, later sibling, deep chain): first-name-pending floor met (65 and 22), shrink-above met (162 and 48), and folders a pending charge moves bytes away from were Unfinished. Not seen on real data: no stale hardlinks there.
Core tests on real NTFS temp trees: 509 + 1189 + 1189 final folders equal to two uninterrupted scans. My real System32 and ProgramData runs: 52,441 final folder comparisons, 0 mismatches.

In the same tests, AtLeast was no higher than the reference for every unfinished folder, including Stops where the rolled figure was above it. Real data: 84,865 unfinished folders, 0 above (no downward correction occurred there).

NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned dumps the whole store (watermark reads included) at return and after the stuck workers wind down: 0 differences. The 30 ms late-write mutant is caught. Code reading: no writer after Finish.
AScanThatRunsToTheEndMarksNothing passed, as did 4 real completed scans marking nothing. The suite is 1096/1096 with no existing test edited.
No per-entry column (one int field). A 4.88M-entry U-201-shape store with checks pending: retained 637.1 MiB, peak 653.5 MiB, within 800 MiB.

obligations.evidence: Code: EndSizeChecks is called only as Finish's first statement (Scanner.cs:583); every return of Execute goes through Finish; ProbePass holds no store reference, so abandoned workers cannot write it; the fitness rule fencing EndSizeChecks holds. Test: NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned re-run green; its dump includes SizeCheckPending, Unfinished and AtLeast, so it reads the watermark. Mutation: a watermark rewrite 30 ms after return turned it red (625 entries differ). A rewrite 300 ms after return survives, because the test looks only through the workers' wind-down; recorded as extra, and sealing the store is SC-408.

not_reached: The shipped App was stopped only on L-004's 60,000-file temp tree. On real folders (System32, ProgramData) I ran the tree's own Core, not the App's results view.

No real stale hardlink first name and no downward size correction occurred on real data (rolledAboveRef 0). The 'at least' subtraction and the hardlink-charge marking were therefore exercised only on the engineered temp trees.
A real 5M-entry or whole-drive Stop: memory was measured on a synthetic 4.88M-entry store.
Cancel on a stalled SMB share with the new Finish write (a person's run, lesson #136).
The App's use of Unfinished and AtLeast: nothing calls them yet (SC-393), so no on-screen at-least figure or per-row note was checked.
Late writes to the store long after the workers wind down: nothing seals the store (SC-408), and the Core test looks only through the wind-down window.
W-001's assertion of the listing-Stop header on a whole-C:\ run.
